# Novatech
> Remote-first managed IT services for small businesses nationwide. Flat-rate pricing, 24/7 monitoring, unlimited help desk, cybersecurity, cloud management, and vCIO strategy.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://novatechsoft.info/): Remote-first managed IT for small businesses
- [Privacy Policy](https://novatechsoft.info/privacy.html): How we collect, use, and protect your personal information

## Key Facts
- Flat-rate pricing: $129-$299/user/month across Essentials, Professional, and Enterprise tiers
- Month-to-month contracts, no lock-in, cancel anytime with 30 days notice
- 15-minute critical response SLA, 24/7/365 monitoring
- Nationwide remote with local field technicians in major metros
- vCIO quarterly strategic reviews included in Professional and Enterprise tiers
- Founded 2025, based in Austin, TX serving nationwide

## Services
- 24/7 Infrastructure Monitoring
- Automated Patch Management
- Remote Help Desk (business hours or 24/7)
- EDR/MDR Cybersecurity
- Cloud Management (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- vCIO Strategic Reviews
- Backup Verification & Disaster Recovery
